subject: strategy-hf-scanner

metrics.what: CSOAI scanner for Hugging Face — produces signed receipts + GSPC axes + policy crosswalks for any model
metrics.csoai_addition: Signed measurement receipt per model — 22 axes, deterministic, reproducible, Bitcoin-anchored

deployment_states.GREEN: All 22 axes measured, no critical failures, signed receipt valid
deployment_states.AMBER: Partial measurement or warnings — requires human review before deployment
deployment_states.RED: Critical axis failures or known safety issues — deployment blocked
deployment_states.UNMEASURED: No CSOAI receipt exists — cannot verify safety

metrics.integration_path: 1) Build HF Space that runs GSPC on any model. 2) Submit as HF community scanner. 3) AGISafe uses receipts for deployment decisions. 4) ASISecurity enforces gates.
metrics.scope: Not claiming to stop all bad use — adding a risk and evidence layer. HF already has security partners. CSOAI adds signed measurement evidence.

honest_sentence: HF scanner: CSOAI measures any HF model → signed receipt + 22 axes + policy crosswalks. AGISafe assigns green/amber/red. ASISecurity enforces gates. Not stopping all bad use — adding evidence.
